summary: Hadiya iteration 6 — pure refactor (server.py modularized into 7 routers + deps.py; Sheet backdrop migrated to Pressable; push.ts already Platform.OS==='web' gated). Backend: 41/41 PASS (100%) via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py — full regression on every endpoint (root, users CRUD, daily-reminder, emotions list + ayah valid/unknown, saved-ayahs POST/GET/DELETE, azkar + progress toggle, sunnah categories/list/of-the-hour/revive, all 7 region method picks (Makkah=4 Umm al-Qura, Karachi=1, London=3 MWL, NYC=2 ISNA, Istanbul=13 Diyanet, Cairo=5 Egyptian, KL=17 JAKIM), prayer-times shape + 422 missing params, hijri-date, all 3 hijri-highlights (ashura/arafah/laylat_al_qadr), notif-prefs GET+PUT, register-push placeholder→{status:'pending', 201}, notifications feed/unread-count/mark-read/preview, all 5 sample categories + unknown 400, notifications/test does not crash with placeholder push key). Refactor structural assertions: server.py = 39 lines (≤60 ✓), /app/backend/routers/ contains all 7 expected modules + __init__.py ✓. APScheduler confirmed running every 60s post-refactor (backend.err.log shows continuous '_dispatch_due' jobs from 12:26 onwards). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, Yusuf seed at Makkah): All 10 sheet open+close flows PASS via backdrop tap-to-close (tasbeeh, feelings, azkar, prayers, settings, sunnah, rhythms, bookmarks, notifications, qibla). Pressable backdrop in Sheet.tsx works identically to previous TouchableWithoutFeedback. No console errors specific to refactor. NOTE: 1 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated' warning still fires once during app boot — verified by `grep -rn TouchableWithoutFeedback /app/frontend/src /app/frontend/app` (zero hits) that NO app source uses it. The warning originates from a library (likely react-native-web's internal Modal or expo-router); not introduced by Hadiya code, not actionable. Carry-over warnings: useNativeDriver web fallback, expo-notifications web token listener (push.ts IS web-gated — the warning fires from the global setNotificationHandler/listener registration in expo-notifications itself before push.ts runs, not from /app/frontend/src/push.ts), react-native-svg transform-origin DOM warning. All pre-existing library-level noise, not regressions.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning still fires once per session despite Sheet.tsx fully migrated to Pressable. Verified via grep — ZERO usages in /app/frontend/src or /app/frontend/app. Source is a library internal (likely react-native-web Modal or expo-router). Not actionable from app code.

Warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' still appears even though /app/frontend/src/push.ts has early-return for Platform.OS==='web'. The warning is emitted by expo-notifications' module-level listener registration (independent of push.ts). Library-level; carried over from iter5.
Console error 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' — emitted by react-native-svg on web. Carried over.
'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Web-only fallback; carried over.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:14-25 — clean and thin (39 lines): app instantiation, router mount loop, CORS, lifecycle hooks. Excellent separation of concerns.

deps.py:22-24 — uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] and os.environ['DB_NAME'] (raises KeyError on missing, fails fast) per coding guidelines. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY uses .get with empty default — appropriate since LLM is optional.
deps.py:39-45 — close_clients tears down both push_client and motor client on shutdown. Correctly wired into server.py's @on_event('shutdown').
routers/__init__.py — exports a `routers` list; server.py just iterates `for r in routers: app.include_router(r)`. Clean plugin pattern; adding an 8th router would be a single line.
routers/users.py:46-58 — doc_to_user explicitly strips '_id' by enumerating fields. Imported and reused by routers/emotions.py (line 12) — good DRY.
routers/emotions.py:46-92 — _generate_reflection wraps LlmChat in try/except with fallback. Resilient to LLM downtime.

routers/prayers.py:16-31 — both hijri endpoints and prayer-times still use `requests` (sync) inside async handlers. Pre-existing pattern from iter5; not a regression introduced by this refactor. Future: switch to httpx.AsyncClient for proper async non-blocking I/O.
routers/notifications.py:34-79 — register_push correctly returns {status:'pending'} with HTTP 201 when push provider returns 401 (placeholder key). Per spec.

Sheet.tsx:67-69 — backdrop Pressable correctly wraps overlay Animated.View; accessibilityRole='button' + accessibilityLabel='Close sheet' make it screen-reader friendly. StyleSheet.absoluteFill ensures full backdrop coverage.
push.ts:15 — `if (Platform.OS === 'web' || !userId) return;` early-return is correct. Web warnings come from expo-notifications module-level code, not from push.ts.

rca_of_issue: No bugs found. One observation: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated' warning still appears even after Sheet.tsx was migrated to Pressable. RCA: `grep -rn TouchableWithoutFeedback /app/frontend/src /app/frontend/app /app/frontend/*.tsx /app/frontend/*.ts` returned 0 matches. Therefore the warning originates from a library — most likely react-native-web's internal <Modal> implementation (which Sheet.tsx still uses as a wrapper) or another dependency. This is NOT a regression from the refactor and not actionable from app code. Mitigation: ignore (library-level) or, if desired in a future iteration, replace the RN Modal in Sheet.tsx with a custom absolute-positioned View overlay to eliminate the Modal's internal TouchableWithoutFeedback.
